notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.notes:
Changes:
 - Fixed some bugs in the several puzzles in the 1,2,3 zone

notes.title: Version 1.2 released.
notes.notes:
What's changed:

[list]
[*] Minor optimizations for the most demanding moments in the game
[*] Solved puzzles now retain the position of the cubes
[*] In solved puzzles, use the "F" key to reset the cubes to the solved state
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1 released
notes.notes:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Added signs to the educational puzzles in the first three zones for easier understanding of the game mechanics by players.
[*] Changed one educational puzzle in the 5th zone to more clearly explain the order of rule application.
[/list]
Added settings:
[list]
[*] Vertical sync
[*] Mouse inversion
[*] Music volume
[/list]
